name: http_get
description: Issue an HTTP GET. Returns a struct with `status`, `reason`, `body`, and `headers` — JSON-extract from there.

name: http_post
description: Issue an HTTP POST with the `params` argument JSON-encoded as the request body. Use for REST APIs that accept JSON.

name: http_post_form
description: Issue an HTTP POST with `application/x-www-form-urlencoded` body. Use for older APIs and HTML form submissions.
